title: Chapter 84
text:
Han Xiao, who was in the logistics area, watched the battle unfold from afar.

In the past, he was used to high-level wars that could easily destroy planets. This low-level ground battle mode made Han Xiao feel very excited. The smell of guns and smoke brought a strong atmosphere of war. In comparison, the psionic cannons and ion cannons that could silently penetrate everything seemed much more 'civilized'.

Han Xiao sat in Big Black's cargo compartment. The two guards guarding him stayed close to the vehicle, as if they were afraid that he would run away.

Lin Yao's voice came through the earpiece.

"Brother Xiao, we will retreat with the enemy's core team. I have planted a virus that can cut off their communication at any time."

"Good job."

"By the way, Uncle Lambert found something. The structure of the inner base is very strong. It seems to be explosion-proof."

Han Xiao frowned as he connected all the dots. He suddenly realized that the outer base was not only a bait, but also a grave. There were probably a lot of explosives hidden there. As long as the intruders stepped into the base, they would explode and take everyone with them into the sky. The explosion could also cause the outer base to collapse and bury all traces. This way, the inner base would be even more hidden.

"Everything is really connected." Han Xiao sighed. Even if he reminded Lin Yao now, it would be too late. Besides, he did not even have the intention to do so.

His plan had finally reached its final stage.

Han Xiao stood up and packed his things. He put all the equipment and some of the precious parts of Big Black into a bulging backpack. "Come and help me carry some things. It's a little heavy," he said to the two guards beside the vehicle.

The two guards did not suspect anything. They walked up to the vehicle and prepared to help Han Xiao carry his backpack.

The moment they bent down, Han Xiao made his move. Two righteous sneak attacks landed on the back of their necks, and the two soldiers were knocked unconscious on the ground without making a sound.

Han Xiao closed the door of the cargo compartment, quietly changed into a soldier's uniform, and took off the mask that he had been carrying. He then activated the facial simulator, changed his appearance, and swaggered out with his backpack, sneaking into the logistics team without anyone noticing.

…

Three minutes ago.

The adjutant rushed back and said, "The people from Division 13 are all here, but Han Xiao is missing!"

Carl was shocked. "Gone?!"

"The two soldiers guarding him were knocked out. I asked the logistics team, but no one saw Han Xiao."

Carl still wanted to say something, but a deafening sound suddenly rang out, giving him a big fright. He quickly looked towards the source of the sound.

The mountain was shaking! The trembling was like an earthquake, causing everyone's expression to change!

The Dark Crow Valley base had self-destructed!

The entire base collapsed, and the entrance was completely sealed by the rubble. The hundreds of elite soldiers inside were all buried alive!

Carl was shocked and angry.

They had fallen into the enemy's trap at the last moment, causing unnecessary casualties. Furthermore, their base had been destroyed, which greatly reduced the value of this victory!

As the commander, he could not escape the blame!

Carl's face darkened. He thought back to Han Xiao's suggestion. If he had accepted it, perhaps he could have avoided these losses. However, if he had to choose again, with his personality and the situation at that time, Carl felt that he would still make the same choice. He felt irritated and slammed his fist on the command vehicle.

The army had suffered heavy losses, and Carl's heart was bleeding. He issued one order after another to calm the soldiers down.

When the agents from Division 13 arrived, Carl asked with a solemn face, "Your teammates are missing. What happened?"

"Han Xiao is missing again?!" The agents from Division 13 looked at each other in shock.

Eh? Why did he add the word 'again'?

Qi Bai Jia's vision turned black.

You f * cking did this again!

Zhang Wei and Li Ya Lin, on the other hand, were very calm. From the perspective of experienced people, they inexplicably felt a trace of superiority.

Wasn't it normal for Han Xiao to act on his own accord? It's fine as long as you get used to it. He must have gone to cause trouble again.

Li Ya Lin snorted and said to Carl, "If he didn't get the confidential information, you would have destroyed the base and thought that you had eliminated all the enemies. You wouldn't even know that the enemy had escaped!"

Carl thought for a moment and realized that this was indeed the case. He was shocked. If the Dark Crow Valley base made a comeback in the future, he would be the first to be held accountable.

"What other information do you have?" Carl couldn't help but ask.

Zhang Wei suppressed his disgust for Carl and said, "Two of our comrades have infiltrated the enemy's evacuation team. Once they confirm the enemy's evacuation route, they will send the information over."

Carl's eyes lit up, and he immediately said, "Inform me immediately if you have any information."

He didn't expect Han Xiao to have done so many things. Fortunately, the losses had exceeded his expectations, and he could only atone for his mistakes by increasing the results of the battle. Intercepting the enemy's core troops was their last chance, and his mistake as a commander could be minimized.

…

In an inconspicuous area ten kilometers away from the Dark Crow Valley base, Pan Kuang, Ji Jie, and more than two hundred core members drove out of the secret passage. They were carrying a large amount of valuable information about the Dark Crow Valley base.

"I guess the Hesla people think that they have won?" Ji Jie couldn't help but smile.

Pan Kuang glanced at him and said, "Don't let your guard down."

Ji Jie nodded and ordered the team to speed up.

In another two hours, they would arrive at a secret hangar. There were a few Black Harriers and a small transport aircraft parked there.

In the team, Lin Yao and Lambert both received Zhang Wei's order through their earphones. They looked at each other and knew that the time had come.

Lin Yao took out a tablet and secretly activated the virus that was buried in the enemy's communication network.

"Screech —"

Everyone's earphones rang at the same time. Everyone was shocked and hurriedly took them off.

Ji Jie was dissatisfied. He wanted to stop the leading car and check the communicator. The next moment, the sound of engines could be heard coming from the surrounding forest. They were surrounded by enemies from all directions.

"Get down!" Pan Kuang's expression changed. He pinned Ji Jie to the ground before he could react. Just as Pan Kuang was about to do this, gunshots rang out.

Bullets rained down on the convoy from all directions. Grenades after grenades overturned the vehicles of the Germinal Organization, and sparks flew everywhere.

Lambert grabbed Lin Yao and jumped out of the car. They rolled on the ground and hid in the woods to avoid direct attacks.

Ji Jie's expression changed. His plan had been exposed! Who leaked the information?

"Run!"

Ji Jie didn't have time to be shocked or depressed. He was dragged into the woods by Pan Kuang.

…

In the woods, Carl was excited. He commanded the soldiers to surround the core of the enemy team. In his opinion, this was the last hope for them to turn the tables.

In the distance, Han Xiao, who had changed his appearance, was driving an off-road vehicle alone. He had a thermal imaging device in his hand and was constantly observing the periphery of the battlefield. Soon, he found his target. Pan Kuang and Ji Jie had broken out of the encirclement and escaped. The soldiers and off-road vehicles that were chasing after them were all destroyed by Pan Kuang's powerful combat ability.

Han Xiao confirmed the location of the two using the thermal imaging device. He then took a big detour and followed them from a few hundred meters behind.

"A car is following us." Pan Kuang turned around. Through the gaps in the woods, he vaguely saw the tracks of the off-road vehicle. The sound of its engine could be heard from afar.

Pan Kuang wanted to kill the car that was following them. However, every time he got close, Han Xiao would turn around and leave, maintaining a fixed distance. Pan Kuang thought that Han Xiao was a specialized reconnaissance vehicle and was reporting their location through the radio. He didn't dare to stop and dragged Ji Jie along. His stamina was greatly depleted.

"As long as we reach the hidden hangar, we can escape by helicopter." This was Pan Kuang's only choice. Although he had superpowers, if he was surrounded by an army, he would be exhausted to death. The sense of danger urged him to speed up. He ignored Ji Jie and was almost foaming at the mouth from exhaustion.

After more than twenty minutes of chasing, both parties were far away from the battlefield.

"It's about time." Han Xiao made up his mind. He compared the military map that he had stolen from the logistics team and took a big detour according to the route that they had taken. The off-road vehicle was even faster. He circled around to a small cliff that was more than ten meters high. He stopped the car, turned off the engine, and put on all his equipment.

He put on the modified Lightweight Mechanical Arm on his left hand and pinned the small case of the Magnetically-Controlled Extendable Armor on his back. He put the Berserk Eagle pistols in the holsters and buried the last ten explosive bombs within five meters of him in a circle to act as simple landmines. A thin wire was connected to all the explosive bombs. He only needed to pull lightly to activate them.

Han Xiao took out a sniper rifle that he had plundered from the logistics team. He crouched on the cliff and aimed in the direction that the two enemies were about to appear. He held his breath and focused.

…

Ji Jie was out of breath. He was not a superhuman, so his stamina was limited. If Pan Kuang hadn't pulled him, he would have collapsed.

Pan Kuang's face was cold. He shouted, "Don't stop. The enemy can come at any time. We need to get to the hangar quickly."

Soon, the two ran out of the forest and saw a mountainous area.

Ji Jie's legs gave out, and he finally sat on the ground. He gasped and said, "I … I can't run anymore."

Pan Kuang frowned. He was a little impatient, but he couldn't leave Ji Jie behind. This guy's sister was one of the people in charge of the intelligence network.

"Why don't you carry me? That way …"

Ji Jie opened his mouth, but before he could finish his sentence, the sound of a sniper rifle rang out.

Pan Kuang reacted quickly and quickly retreated.

However, the target of the sniper rifle was not him.

Ji Jie's head shook violently as if he had been punched. A bloody hole suddenly appeared on the left side of his face. The powerful momentum caused the bullet to roll around in his skull and shatter the right side of his face. Blood and flesh splattered all over the ground. Ji Jie's expression froze on his face, and he slowly fell to the ground. He couldn't have been more dead.

[Beheading II] completed. Damage: 100%. You received 40000 EXP!
